name: RogSi (Rograkh + Silas Renn cEDH)
notes:
DeckCheck scan of https://deckcheck.co/app/decklist/kYIIDZ5dUUrp (creator user3684658), CRISPI 9.81, Bracket 5. Decklist verified card-for-card against this file (100 cards, no diffs).

CONSISTENCY 10 — Complete Breakdown.
Base tutor points, 13 cards = 66 pts. Premium tutor +6 each: Demonic Tutor, Diabolic Intent, Gamble, Imperial Seal, Mystical Tutor, Vampiric Tutor, Wishclaw Talisman. Standard / restricted tutor +4 each: Demonic Consultation, Doomsday, Grim Tutor, Lim-Dul's Vault, Opposition Agent, Tainted Pact.
Functional redundancy bonus = +20 pts, lifting the read to 10: +10 "15 cards filling the 'manaless-value' role"; +5 "11 cards filling the 'adds-multiple-mana' role"; +5 "11 cards filling the 'life-payment' role".
66 pts + 20 redundancy bonus = 86 tutor points -> counts as 10.
Card draw & selection: base draw points listed over 20 cards (Ad Nauseam +6 the largest single entry); the column total was not captured.

RESILIENCE 10 - multiple non-overlapping combo vectors (Thassa's Oracle, Underworld Breach, Doomsday); Silas Renn adds incidental artifact recursion if an engine is countered.

INTERACTION 9.75 - a robust 25-card interaction suite; free counterspells named: Force of Will, Deflecting Swat, Fierce Guardianship.

SPEED 9.5 - band table maps Speed 9.5 to win turns 2-3. Judged by the AI, not by formula (see the Speed RULE APPLIED text recorded in braids-conjurer-adept.json).
DeckCheck's stated curve: T1 cast Rograkh, play an untapped land, drop fast mana (Mox Amber or Sol Ring) and hold up interaction or cast a tutor; T2 leverage rituals - Dark Ritual or Culling the Weak - into Ad Nauseam, drawing into Lotus Petal and Lion's Eye Diamond to cast Thassa's Oracle plus Demonic Consultation for the win. Stated bottleneck: assembling enough initial black and red mana to cast both a card engine and combo protection on the same turn.
